stories.title: ShinyHunters-Exploited Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day Turns Out to Be Three Chained Flaws
stories.summary: The critical Oracle PeopleSoft bug that ShinyHunters has exploited since May is not one flaw but three chained together, the researchers who reported it said this week. Oracle patched all three under a single identifier, CVE-2026-35273, in June. Its root is a server-side request forgery (SSRF) that reaches an internal management interface because PeopleSoft trusts its own loopback address

stories.title: Adobe Commerce PolyShell Attacks Breach Hundreds of Stores as Brotli Exploit Traffic Emerges
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added two vulnerabilities impacting Adobe Commerce and Magento, and Google's Brotli decoder library to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. stories.title: Japan's GMO urges customers to shut down PCs amid ransomware threat
stories.summary: The GMO Group has urged customers to disconnect their systems from the internet and shut down computers after a threat actor who breached the company's Onamae Desktop Cloud threatened to launch a ransomware attack today.

stories.title: CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of Two PHP2Shell Flaws Enabling Remote Code Execution
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday confirmed active exploitation of the recently patched PHP2Shell flaws by adding them to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. The PHP vulnerabilities, both rated 9.2 on the CVSS scoring system, facilitate unauthenticated remote code execution on affected deployments - CVE-2026-109618 - An out-of-memory

stories.title: HPE Patches Dozens of Critical Flaws in Networking Products
stories.summary: Eight max-severity security defects could lead to remote code execution and authentication bypass.

stories.title: CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.

stories.title: Hackers Start Probing Fresh Oracle EBS Vulnerability
stories.summary: CVE-2026-101767 is an unauthenticated SQL injection that can be exploited for remote code execution.

stories.title: CISA warns of hackers now exploiting critical Node2Shell flaw
stories.summary: On Tuesday, the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) confirmed that hackers have begun exploiting a critical Brotli vulnerability known as Node2Shell, Broccoli2Shell, and HTTP2Shell.
